name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT ZERO〈SC仕様〉 -ACTION-
name.en: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT ZERO〈SC specification〉 -ACTION-

description.ja: ULTRAMAN外伝企画『ULTRAMAN SUIT ANOTHER UNIVERSE Episode:ZERO』より、時空突入のためにコーティングを施されたZERO SUITの新たな姿、「ULTRAMAN SUIT ZERO<SC仕様>」が広域可動の-ACTION-仕様で商品化！
description.en: From the ULTRAMAN Gaiden project "ULTRAMAN SUIT ANOTHER UNIVERSE Episode: ZERO ", a new form of ZERO SUIT coated for space-time entry, " ULTRAMAN SUIT ZERO <SC specification>" is commercialized in -ACTION- specification with wide range movement!

description.ja: ■清水栄一先生監修デザインのプラモデルオリジナル武装「ワイドゼロショット」が付属。
description.en: • Comes with a plastic model original weapon "Wide Zero Shot" designed under the supervision of Eiichi Shimizu.

description.ja: ■「ワイドゼロショット」はグリップの収納が可能。
description.en: • "Wide Zero Shot" allows the grip to be stored.

description.ja: ■腹部に複数のボールジョイントを設け、可動域をアップ。前屈や腹部のひねりに対応。
description.en: • Multiple ball joints in the abdomen increase range of motion. Supports forward bends and abdominal twists.

description.ja: ■腹部パーツは可動優先タイプと別売りLED内蔵タイプの2タイプから選択可能。
description.en: • There are two types of abdominal parts to choose from: a movable type and a built-in LED type (sold separately).

description.ja: ■ゼロランスやディスプレイ用台座など、豊富なパーツが付属。
description.en: • Comes with a variety of parts such as zero lance and display pedestal.

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ（左右）×各2種
accessories.en: Hand parts (left and right) x 2 types each
